source.title: Data source
source.description: page: items embedded in the page (counts computed here); json: a public JSON file; api: the Catalog product (facet counts from GET /v1/items).

source_url.title: JSON file URL
source_url.description: The public JSON file (json source): https, or a path on this website. api sources need no URL or key: the Loader passes the product client.

page_data_id.title: Page data element id
page_data_id.description: Id of the <script type="application/json"> holding the data when the source is the page.

currency.title: Default currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code for items without their own currency (empty: prices without a currency are not shown).

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: BCP 47 language tag for prices and sorting (empty: the page language).

fields.title: Field mapping
fields.description: Which JSON fields hold each item property; | separates alternatives (url|href), dots reach nested values (images.0.url). Empty fields use the defaults.

facets.title: Facets
facets.description: Facets in display order: key (brand, collection, price, in_stock or an attribute key), label, type (values, range, toggle) and multi-select.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: sidebar (always open), sheet (a button opens a panel; best on mobile) or top_bar (one disclosure per facet).

show_counts.title: Show counts
show_counts.description: Show how many items each value has.

max_values.title: Values per facet
max_values.description: Most values listed per facet (most frequent first).

param_prefix.title: URL parameter prefix
param_prefix.description: Prefix for the URL parameters (must match the grid).

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: Where and when the element renders: the shared placement v1 (paths, selectors, page types, devices, referrers, schedule, consent, triggers, frequency incl. cooldown and dismiss memory, audience rule). The Loader enforces it.
